task: Draft a title, body text, and action labels for a macOS save-changes dialog in a fictional text editor. Use the explicitly supplied implementation facts: this dialog has no default button, pressing Return at initial focus does not save, and pressing Escape equals Cancel. Do not infer platform defaults not supplied.

facts.text: The dialog appears when a user closes a document with unsaved changes.
The action Save document writes the changes and closes the document.
The action Discard changes closes the document and discards all unsaved changes.
The action Cancel returns to the document without closing it.
This dialog has no default button; pressing Return at initial focus does not activate any action.
Pressing Escape has the same effect as Cancel in this dialog.
Unsaved changes are not recoverable after Discard changes is activated.

forbidden_additions: Return-triggers-save behavior not in the supplied implementation.
A default button not described in the facts.
An undo or recovery route after Discard changes.
preserve: Three actions: Save document, Discard changes, Cancel.
No default button; Return does not activate any action.
Escape equals Cancel in this implementation.
